statement_unchanged: Check behind and on both sides before changing lanes for a turn. Choose the proper lane early; if you cannot reach it at least half a block before the turn, continue straight. Give the turn signal at least 100 feet ahead. A hand signal should show your intent before the junction, then end for the turn so both hands can steer.
